title: Finance Executive
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

· Handle day\-to\-day accounting entries and maintain books of accounts.

· Record and verify sales, purchase, receipt, payment, and journal entries.

· Maintain and update ledgers, vouchers, invoices, and other accounting documents.

· Assist in ledger scrutiny and identify discrepancies or pending entries.

· Perform vendor and customer reconciliation and follow up on discrepancies.

· Assist with GST, TDS, and other statutory compliance\-related activities.

· Support the Accounts Team in preparing MIS, financial reports, and routine accounting reports.

· Maintain proper documentation and records for audit and compliance purposes.

· Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and customers for accounting\-related queries.

· Support the team in other day\-to\-day finance and accounting activities as required.

**You Must**

· 0–2 years of experience in Accounts/Finance.

· Graduate in B.Com, M.Com, or a related field.

· Hands\-on experience with Tally/Tally Prime and familiarity with accounting entries and ledger management.

· Knowledge of GST, TDS, and statutory compliance.

· Good working knowledge of MS Excel.

· Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

· Good communication and organizational skills.

· Internship experience in Accounts/Finance will be an added advantage.

If this is exciting to you, kindly share your resume with **pinku.kumar@team1consulting.com**

**Subject:** Finance\_ {First Name}

Please include:

* Current Location
* Total Experience
* Relevant Experience
* Current Salary
* Salary Expectations
* Notice Period

Pay: ₹250,000\.00 \- ₹300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
